blocks.label: My role at a glance
items: I led the member-first redesign of CareHub, end to end.
I shaped the AI summary prompts: what to show, for which trigger, with examples.
I turned workflow data and evaluation results into design priorities.

blocks.html: CareHub showed one workflow at a time, even when a member had several in progress. Clinicians searched across tabs to piece together the full picture.

items: workflows open per member, on average
click rate on the Interactions tab
members a clinician handles each day

blocks.html: I set a member-first vision and a staged path to get there.
The first step was simple: put everything open for a member on one screen, next to the conversation.

blocks.text: First try: the care plan in its own view

blocks.alt: An early CareHub exploration in motion: the care plan, treatment and action plans in their own view.
blocks.label: Why we moved on
pills: Shrank the chat clinicians rely on
Broke on small windows and with 3+ workflows
blocks.cap: Care plan, treatment and action plans got their own view.

blocks.text: What shipped: every open task, one glance

blocks.alt: The final CareHub member view: every open task above the summary, beside the conversation.
blocks.cap: Open tasks sit above the summary, beside the full-size conversation. It works at any window size and with any number of workflows.

blocks.text: Milestone 2: understand it at a glance
The problem: too long to read

blocks.html: A PT sees 90–110 members a day. The existing summary gave each one a paragraph, so it went unread.

card.meta: Generated by HH AI 2 hours ago
card.name: Ella’s summary
parts: Theresa is a 55-year-old female paralegal from
Vassalboro, ME, who is committed to staying active for her grandchildren.
She last engaged in an exercise session on August 27, 2024, and reported a pain score of 9/100.

blocks.side: Paragraphs can be long and difficult to read

blocks.text: The change: context first, events below

blocks.html: We restructured the summary and rewrote the prompt from scratch: short insights to orient, then the events that need action.

card.title: Needs help with sudden pain increase
insights: Pain has reduced by 30 over 4 weeks after adding squats to the routine.
Mentioned feeling stronger while climbing stairs in the health log on 24th Sept.
notes: Quick context to orient the team
Every insight linked to its source

blocks.html: To earn trust, clinicians could rate every summary in a few seconds, and their feedback shaped the next prompt.

card.question: How do you feel about this summary?

blocks.label: Impact
items: Milestone 2, with ~1% less time per member.

blocks.html: AI summaries were ~73.5% correct in evaluation, so recommendations are still in progress.
